title: Rundu service-station protest over worker abuse
reason: The reported demand targeted a private service-station owner and sought closure of that business over abuse of workers; the consulted account does not identify a demand directed at Namibian state policy or conduct.
notes: CIVICUS Monitor body consulted in February reports the 3 March protest and subsequent employer suspension (Feb raw_body_001.json lines 41–42). Excluded on target predicate, not on attendance; turnout is unknown. No March body was opened for this item.
